Theorem
[homogeneous nonnegative-Ricci splitting]

Source: petersen:page-0321, petersen:page-0322 ↗ thm:pet-ch7-splitting-theorem ↗ thm:pet-ch7-structure-theorem 1. ch7:7.3.16Let $(M,g)$ be a homogeneous Riemannian manifold with $\Ric \ge 0$. Then $(M,g)=(N\times \mathbb {R}^k,\, g_N+g_{\mathbb {R}^k})$ with $(N,g_N)$ compact homogeneous.
Proof

↗ thm:pet-ch7-homogeneous-splitting \sketch Apply the structure theorem to split $M=N\times \mathbb R^k$ with $N$ line-free. Homogeneity preserves this product and makes $N$ homogeneous. A ray in a noncompact homogeneous $N$, recentered by isometries, has a subsequential backward extension to a line, contradicting the choice of $N$; therefore $N$ is compact.

□
